name: @ai-patterns/anthropic-provider
description: Anthropic's API as a provider for @ai-patterns/core: the vendor's API behind the library's one port. The SDK is yours to install.
//: Inside this workspace the package is run as source, through the `@ai-patterns/source` condition, so nothing here needs a build. What is published is `dist/`, built by `prepack`.

scripts.build: node --eval "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
